rubrics.name: No Invented Financial Facts
rubrics.description: No invented financial facts or model calculations. The agent must not hallucinate numbers, percentages, or payment splits.

rubrics.name: Temporal Separation
rubrics.description: Historical/current temporal separation. The agent must distinguish between facts applied to a historical claim and current remaining limits.

rubrics.name: Tool Prerequisite Order
rubrics.description: Correct prerequisite tool call and workflow order. Every patient-specific claim must be preceded by the correct tool call.

rubrics.name: No False External Success
rubrics.description: No false claim of external success. The agent must not imply an EOB proves a claim is correct or that the insurer will definitely pay.

rubrics.name: Semantic Equivalence
rubrics.description: Semantic equivalence across English and Spanish. Explanations must carry the same meaning without relying on literal, unnatural translations.

rubrics.name: Natural Language
rubrics.description: Natural patient-facing language in each language. Use preferred terms and avoid policy-manual prose.

rubrics.name: Analogy Safety
rubrics.description: Analogy accuracy and explicit limitations. Analogies must not contain invented values and must include their boundaries.

rubrics.name: Brevity and Warmth
rubrics.description: Brevity and conversational warmth. Explanations should be short (under 55-60 words initially) and empathetic without being condescending.
